en: Choose a primary language and an optional secondary language from Chinese, English and Korean. Korean catalog names, search and name copying are supported, with fallback when a translation is unavailable.
Browse 135 enchantment scrolls by color and event category, plus a directory of 1,317 client equipment records. Search by scroll, equipment or material.

Use separate item and character / mercenary cost calculators. Browse craftable characters by category without entering a search, choose a crafting or progression route, and enter material prices, prerequisite-character acquisition costs and fees. Unknown costs remain distinct from zero.

Expand item recipes inside character calculations, including nested materials such as Force Beads (Flame) and Five color powder. Reuse saved item cost sheets or return to manual prices, with quantities, whole batches, surplus and crafting fees recalculated at each level.
zh-TW: 新增主語言與可選的次語言設定，可自由選擇中文、英文或韓文。支援韓文圖鑑名稱、搜尋及名稱複製；缺少翻譯時會使用可用語言。
新增鬼道圖鑑，可按顏色及活動分類瀏覽 135 個秘訣，另設 1,317 筆客戶端裝備記錄目錄，並可搜尋秘訣、裝備與材料。
計算功能分為道具及角色／傭兵兩個分頁。可依分類直接選擇可合成角色，再選擇合成或進階路線，填入材料單價、前置角色取得成本及費用；未知成本與零成本分開顯示。
角色計算可逐層展開道具材料配方，例如精氣之珠（火）及五色粉末，並可重用已收藏的道具成本表或切回手填單價；各層需求量、製作批次、餘量及合成費會同步重算。

en: Open the matching cost calculator directly from craftable item and character details or previews. Reopening the same target preserves entered quantities, prices, nested recipes and unfinished input.

Enchantment details show materials, applicable equipment, abilities, equipment requirements and success rates. Full-mode lists preview abilities, success rates, equipment and materials, with links to related records. Relevant NPC details include fortune-telling and grade-specific enchantment fees; penalties and missing ability data remain explicit.

Expand MCP queries with supported game nicknames, short questions, town and facility searches, filters, focused details, paginated relationships and comparisons. Ambiguous matches return choices, and repeated lookups use cached indexes.
Resolve an item and calculate direct materials and costs for a requested quantity in one MCP query. Multiple recipes require a choice, and missing prices remain unknown.

Export item cost sheets as JPGs in the background while continuing to edit. Completion or failure notices remain available after leaving the calculator, including when images were saved but could not be opened.
zh-TW: 可從能合成的道具或角色詳情及預覽，直接開啟對應的成本計算器。再次開啟同一目標時保留數量、價格、子配方及尚未完成的輸入。
鬼道詳情顯示材料、適用裝備、能力、裝備需求與成功率；完整模式列表亦可預覽能力、成功率、裝備及材料，並開啟相關記錄。相關 NPC 詳情列出點卦費及各級附魔費，負面能力與缺失資料會明確標示。
擴充 MCP 查詢，支援已收錄的遊戲俗稱、簡短問法、城鎮與設施搜尋、條件篩選、指定詳情、關聯分頁及多項比較；同名或多個候選會列出選項，重複查詢亦改用快取索引。
MCP 可在一次查詢中辨識道具並計算指定數量的直接材料與成本；多個配方會要求選擇，未填價格仍標示為未知。
道具成本表改為背景匯出 JPG，匯出期間可繼續編輯；離開計算器後仍會顯示完成或失敗通知，並分清圖片已儲存但無法開啟的情況。

en: Fix missing synthesis materials for some characters, including Virudhaka (T51). Compatible saved estimates receive the missing materials while retaining entered prices and quantities.

Correct inconsistent beast credit-level requirements. MCP mount acquisition details now include recorded prerequisite mounts, materials and fees, with riding training kept separate from acquisition costs.
Restore MCP enchantment-material usage links and quest links for worn or used items, preserving recorded requirements and quantities. Exact item-alias searches no longer include unrelated matches.
Validate alias names and item IDs before saving, identify the failing row and retain edits. Failed saves leave active aliases unchanged and do not overwrite unreadable existing files.
Show a retry action when settings cannot be saved, retaining the latest changes while the app remains open. Failed favourite saves keep the previous state instead of appearing successful.
Validate monster HP, hit-resistance and magic-resistance filter ranges. Invalid numbers or a minimum above the maximum now show an error instead of being treated as unrestricted.
Show copy success only after details, cost-sheet codes or folder codes reach the clipboard. Failures prompt a retry and leave cost sheets unchanged.
zh-TW: 修正部分角色合成材料遺漏，包括增長天王（T51）；相容的既有計算草稿會補回缺少的材料，並保留已填價格與數量。
修正部分神獸信用等級條件不一致。MCP 坐騎取得資料補上已記錄的前置坐騎、材料及費用，並將騎術訓練需求與取得成本分開。
補回 MCP 附魔材料用途，以及任務穿戴／使用道具的關聯查詢，保留已記錄的條件與數量；精確道具別名搜尋亦不再混入無關結果。
儲存別名前檢查名稱及道具編號，指出有問題的列並保留修改；儲存失敗時不套用別名，也不覆蓋無法讀取的既有檔案。
設定儲存失敗時提供「重試儲存」，程式開啟期間會保留最新修改供重試；收藏儲存失敗時維持原本狀態，避免顯示成已成功收藏。
驗證怪物體力、打擊抗性及魔法抗性的篩選範圍；錯誤數字或最低值高於最高值時顯示原因，避免被當成不限範圍。
複製詳情、成本表分享碼或資料夾分享碼時，只有剪貼簿寫入成功才顯示成功訊息；失敗會提示重試並保留成本表。

en: Copy Chinese and English record names separately from detail headings, without IDs, quantities or descriptions.
Open full character details with portraits, base stats, skills and progression links. The catalog now includes 15 mounts and 33 spirit forms, with bundled portraits and animation previews.
See recorded monster drop rates beside items and through MCP. Unknown rates remain marked as unavailable, and normal and single-player drop conditions stay separate.
zh-TW: 可在詳情頁標題分別複製中文及英文名稱，不包含編號、數量或說明。
角色可開啟完整詳情，查看頭像、基礎能力、技能及進階關聯。圖鑑新增 15 隻坐騎及 33 個精靈形態，並附帶頭像及動畫預覽。
怪物掉落物旁及 MCP 查詢均可查看已記錄的掉落率；未知機率維持未記錄，並分開保留一般與單人限定的掉落條件。

en: Expand a character region into ranks, with consistent ordering, region-specific counts and representative portraits for categories.
Mount lists show riding requirements and movement bonuses. Spirit lists group by family element and grade; details show skill effects first, with base stats available on demand.
Show a spirit's required previous form, intimacy and materials on the form being obtained, including grade-four-to-five recipes on grade-five pages. Keep the next-form navigation link.
Find monster drops by item name, alias or item code, then sort by recorded drop rate and highlight the selected item. Unknown rates sort last; multiple slots are not added together.
Choose calculator folders directly by name and icon, with keyboard navigation and a layout that adapts to narrow windows.

Keep full-mode navigation in place when selecting the current sidebar page. Back follows the current hierarchy, while Escape first dismisses calculator dialogs and returns from saved sheets to the editor.
zh-TW: 角色地區目錄可展開階級，採用一致的階級次序，並顯示該地區的角色數量及分類代表頭像。
坐騎列表直接顯示馬術要求及移速加成。精靈按系別與階級排列，詳情優先顯示技能效果，基礎能力可按需展開。
精靈的前置形態、所需親密度及材料顯示在目標形態頁，例如五階頁顯示四階升至五階的條件，並保留前往下一形態的連結。
可按道具名稱、別名或編號尋找掉落怪物，再依已記錄掉落率排序並標示所選道具。未知機率排在最後，多個掉落欄位不合併計算。
計算器收藏、儲存及移動合成表時，可直接按資料夾名稱與圖示選取，並支援鍵盤導覽及窄視窗排列。
完整模式重按目前側欄頁面時保留現有狀態；返回操作依循目前層級，Escape 則先關閉計算器對話框，再從收藏返回編輯器。

en: Keep copy feedback centered at the bottom of the content area, without adding a border around the copied name.
Prevent item and character names from collapsing to only an ellipsis in lists, and keep companion summaries and icons aligned.
Preserve the cursor and draft text while editing calculator quantities and comma-separated prices. Invalid fields remain visible and prevent saving or exporting until corrected.
Make recipe and unit-price actions respond to the first click. Materials with a single recipe expand immediately without an extra recipe picker.
Remove duplicate formation recipes that showed incorrect output quantities, keeping crafting batches and fees consistent with the current recipes.
zh-TW: 複製回饋固定在內容區底部中央顯示，不再為已複製名稱加上邊框。
修正道具及角色在列表上可能只顯示省略號的問題，並保持坐騎、精靈摘要與圖片對齊。
編輯計算器數量及含千位分隔符的單價時保留游標與輸入文字；無效欄位會保留供修正，全部修正前不能儲存或匯出。
修正配方及單價操作需要再次點擊的問題；只有一個配方的材料會直接展開，毋須再次選擇。
移除產出數量不正確的重複陣型配方，讓製作批次及費用依照現行配方計算。

en: Connect Codex, Cursor or Claude to the local, read-only catalog through stdio MCP. Full mode includes setup guides for catalog search, drops, quest dependencies, recipes and direct-material cost calculations.
Browse quests by chain, quest giver or region in full mode, with objective and reward icons and a zoomable prerequisite roadmap.
Calculate crafting costs in full mode using your own material prices. Optionally expand nested recipes or reuse a saved cost sheet, with indented sub-materials and crafting fees included.
Save cost sheets in folders, share individual sheets or entire folders using offline codes, and export JPGs with automatic pagination for long lists.
Read bundled release history offline in English or Traditional Chinese, following your language setting.
zh-TW: 透過本機唯讀 stdio MCP，讓 Codex、Cursor 或 Claude 查詢圖鑑。完整模式提供連接教學，支援圖鑑搜尋、掉落、任務依賴、配方及直接材料成本計算。
完整模式可按任務鏈、委託 NPC 或地區瀏覽任務，並以圖示查看目標及獎勵，以及可縮放的前置任務路線圖。
完整模式可按自行輸入的材料單價計算合成成本，並選擇展開子配方或重用已收藏的成本表；子材料以縮排顯示，合成費用亦納入計算。
可將成本表存入資料夾，以離線分享碼傳送單份表格或整個資料夾，並匯出 JPG；長清單會自動分頁。
可離線查看隨程式附帶的更新紀錄，並依語言設定顯示英文或繁體中文。

en: Full and widget modes share consistent colors and bilingual item names. Full-mode search preserves browsing context, with clearer previews and side-by-side item and set details.
Settings adapt to the full-mode window width, with improved keyboard navigation and full-name previews for long catalog entries.
Improve large-catalog browsing performance by caching image work and limiting rendering to visible list rows.
zh-TW: 完整與小窗模式統一配色及雙語道具名稱；完整模式搜尋保留瀏覽位置，並提供更清晰的預覽及並排顯示的道具、套裝詳情。
設定頁會按完整模式的視窗寬度調整排列，並改善鍵盤導覽，讓較長的圖鑑名稱可完整預覽。
透過圖片處理快取及只繪製可見清單列，改善大型圖鑑的瀏覽效能。

en: Limit global F1–F9 shortcuts and the Keys settings page to widget mode, and remove shortcut hints from full-mode navigation.
Keep empty quest search results inside the quest browser, with a clear-search action.
zh-TW: 全域 F1–F9 快捷鍵及快捷鍵設定頁只在小窗模式提供，並移除完整模式導覽列的快捷鍵提示。
任務搜尋沒有結果時仍保留任務瀏覽介面，並提供清除搜尋操作。

en: Keep the saved window mode and size when the app starts.
zh-TW: 修正程式啟動時可能未能保留已儲存的視窗模式及大小。

en: Download a portable Windows x64 ZIP and open the app without installing development tools.
Check for updates, download a new version, and restart to update inside the app while keeping favourites, aliases, and settings.
Browse the bundled item and monster catalog and pictures offline.
zh-TW: 提供 Windows x64 免安裝 ZIP，解壓後即可開啟程式，毋須安裝開發工具。
可在程式內檢查更新、下載新版及重新啟動更新，並保留收藏、別名及設定。
離線亦可瀏覽隨程式附帶的道具、怪物資料及圖片。
